approvalGate: FIX-003 operator approval pending; hashes below pin the deterministic build so approval binds instantly when granted

alphaMeasurements.note: All 16 sources measured; alpha content touches the frame edge in every file, so uniform-fit resize preserves all content (no crop). Only 13-multipose-sheet has two bounded row bands.

compact.why: Fits 420px app window at native 941:1672 aspect; preserves every source pixel of a fullbody original with no cropping or background filling
compact.note: 741px rendering is CSS min-height in the 640px shell; 746 is the honest 420px-aspect number and never stretches

fullbody.why: Native resolution for on-demand full-quality inspection
fullbody.note: Native-size re-encode of non-cropped sources; pixels are identical to the source, container bytes differ (PNG IHDR/metadata), which the two-build hash comparison still pins deterministically

face.why: Half-height 0.3 scale of the 1254px face tier (spec face state scale); keeps the whole 1254x1254 square, no crop
face.note: Face overlays never flatten onto light/black; alpha preserved

portrait.why: 0.3 scale of the 1024x1536 portrait tier, measured against the 420px stage so a portrait never exceeds the shell
portrait.note: On-demand poses only; FIX-003/QC owns semantic assignment

sheet-pose-a.why: Alpha-band crop of 13-multipose-sheet row A (measured, source pixels only), fit to 0.3 scale of its own band
sheet-pose-a.note: Crop rectangle pinned in this spec; extraction reproduces byte-identical outputs

sheet-pose-b.why: Alpha-band crop of 13-multipose-sheet row B (measured, source pixels only), fit to 0.3 scale of its own band
sheet-pose-b.note: Crop rectangle pinned in this spec; extraction reproduces byte-identical outputs

PNG.colorProfile: preserve-only-if-source-has-one (measured: none of the 16 sources carry an ICC profile)

WEBP.note: Measured before choosing: Pillow 11.3 'lossless' WebP is still lossy in RGB (measured max channel diff 255 on fullbody re-encode), so the spec declares WebP honestly as lossy quality=95. Alpha stays exact; RGB is a 95-quality approximation of the source pixels. PNG is the lossless derivative.

determinism.tool: python3 + Pillow (pinned version recorded in DERIVATIVE-MANIFEST.json tool field)
rules: Read sources in sorted filename order
Iterate tiers and inputs in spec order (JSON arrays)
Fixed encoder parameters (PNG compress_level=6, optimize=False; WEBP lossless=False, quality=95, method=6)
Fixed file mtime 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z on every output (sources keep their own mtimes; never rewritten)
No randomness, no timestamps, no hostname, no absolute paths embedded in any output
PIL LANCZOS resize is deterministic for these fixed inputs and parameters (verified by two-build hash comparison)

prohibited: No generated, synthesized, or AI-produced art may enter derived/
No background fill, flattening, or color manipulation — sources pass through encode unchanged except resize/crop
No reading source bytes into model context (DOC-ASSET-HANDLING-NOTE.md rules apply to every asset lane)
